# Tree shapes for scripts/preflight.sh. test-preflight.sh builds each case's entries in a new, empty working
# directory outside any repository and runs preflight there, with no arguments, under each bash, in both modes.
# One case per line: <exit status><TAB><the one stderr line, empty for status 0><TAB><entry>[<TAB><entry>...].
# An entry is d:<path> (a directory), f:<path> (an empty file), j:<path>=<text> (a file holding <text>) or
# l:<path>=<target> (a symbolic link to <target>); the directories above <path> are made too. The status is
# the one under AUDITOR_STRICT=1. A letter after it says what default mode does (OUTPUT-RULES.md Rule 11f):
#   - none: the same in both modes;
#   - s: in default mode the case passes, with nothing on stderr, a note naming the path the refusal names, and a
#     default-mode ok line last;
#   - u: a .claude/settings.local.json that is the user's own in default mode, outside a repository: the case passes,
#     with nothing on stderr and the ok line last (and a note when the file sets hooks or env).
# A status-64 case prints nothing on stdout; a status-0 case prints nothing on stderr and ends with the ok line. No
# case changes anything in the working directory.
